text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...That gate was noble, magnificent, and 
a place everyone yearned to reach. Yet it 
was also a gate where so many were 
crushed—"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, as long as there are those who 
pursue their dreams without giving up, the 
path will continue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are those captivated by 
the world's summit, the path will go on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once again this year, those with a spark 
of romance in their hearts gather, aiming 
for glory on French soil. The dream 
towards the world continues—
